$comment: sherpa-provider — GENERATED by scripts/generate-component-spec.mjs from its .html, .css and .ts. Regenerate it, never edit it. $extensions.sherpa is kept across regen; resync-figma.mjs owns it.
$description: the data layer, over a SUBTREE of the page.

props.name: data-keep-content
props.description: every card it draws a state on keeps its content: a bar and a banner, never an overlay. Will, TODO 59. (the rest — `provide()` gives it its sources)

slots.description: the subtree — every component in it can ask

populate.description: Its declared props by name: `label` sets data-label.

capabilities.description: read/write JS properties (filterMode, limitOptions, hideUnmatched, reach, savedFilterSets, customView, view). See $extensions.sherpa.jsProps.

callable from a view definition's state block (provide, open, prepare, recheck, close, saveView, deleteView, saveFilters, applyFilters, dismissFilters, deleteFilters, resetView, export, import). See $extensions.sherpa.methods.

events.name: filter-mode-change
events.description: The filters moved between the toolbars and the panel.

events.name: view-change
events.description: A View was picked, opened or saved.

events.name: reach-change
events.description: Whether the page's data can be reached changed.

methods.name: provide
methods.description: Give this subtree its sources — and its Views. Every component already asking is answered again: a Context that swaps its source swaps it for everything in it. Settles once the kept Query, or the start View, is on.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Set up a page from its DEFINITION: its source over the app's store, every filter bar drawn from its scope — the View chip, the fields it holds, what it may add — and all of it provided. The source, or undefined for a page with no data.

methods.name: prepare
methods.description: A page is about to be drawn from this definition, or from none: take its filter mode NOW — the panel open or shut — so its content is never drawn twice. `open()` follows.

methods.name: recheck
methods.description: Try every source that cannot reach its store again — a page's Retry.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Leave the page, or one still opening: its source goes, and nothing in the subtree reaches it. `next`: another page follows at once, and says whether the panel stays.

methods.name: saveView
methods.description: Save what is on screen as a View of the open page, and put it on the View chip. With a name, a NEW View — a name any View has already gets ` - Copy-001`. With none, over the reader's own View on screen; a preset is never overwritten, so that answers undefined. The saved View's id, else undefined. `stay`: keep it for later, and stay on the View on screen — the save before a Reset all to default.

methods.name: deleteView
methods.description: Delete the reader's own View — the one on screen unless named — and go to the first. A preset is never deleted.

methods.name: saveFilters
methods.description: SAVE FILTERS — every scope's filters under a name, kept with the page beside its Views. A set of the same name is saved over, so a host asks first. With none, over the set last taken ("Save <name>"); none taken answers undefined. The set's id. Will, TODO 105, 366.

methods.name: applyFilters
methods.description: TAKE a saved set: every scope matches it; one it does not name has no filters.

methods.name: dismissFilters
methods.description: TAKE a saved set OFF: the scopes it names lose their filters.

methods.name: deleteFilters
methods.description: DELETE a saved set — the one last taken unless named. Its filters stay on screen.

methods.name: resetView
methods.description: Put the filters back as the View on screen DEFINES them: the page's first Query, then the View's, as a pick puts it on. A filter the reader added since goes. What "Reset all to default" does.

methods.name: export
methods.description: This subtree's whole state as JSON — each source's question, and the View on screen — for a link, another service or an agent.

methods.name: import
methods.description: Take a state back in, exactly: each named source's question, and its View — shown on the View chip, and known to the pick listener, so the next pick of the old View is heard. A source it does not name is left as it is.

jsProps.name: savedFilterSets
jsProps.type: { id: string; label: string; applied: boolean }[]
